name: Peak near Cabeus B (candidate region)
mission: Artemis crewed landing (regions announced for Artemis III; first landing now Artemis IV, 2028)
coord_note: Region list from NASA (Oct 2024). Coordinates are the USGS gazetteer center of the named feature 'Cabeus B' (http://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/8058) used as a PROXY - NASA did not publish region-center coordinates; actual region may be offset by tens of km. Not verified as the region centre.

name: Haworth (candidate region)
mission: Artemis crewed landing (regions announced for Artemis III; first landing now Artemis IV, 2028)
coord_note: Region list from NASA (Oct 2024). Coordinates = center of the bounds of the LROC NAC mosaic made for this region, 'Haworth ... low-Sun controlled NAC mosaic' (https://data.lroc.im-ldi.com/lroc/view_rdr/NAC_ROI_HAWORTH_LOC, bounds -87.39..-86.11 lat, -34.98..-12.36 lon). PROXY: mosaic center, not an official region center. Previously the USGS center of Haworth crater (-87.45, -5.17), which lies on the permanently shadowed crater floor (0% Sun, 0% Earth with the LOLA horizon).

name: Nobile Rim 1 (candidate region)
mission: Artemis crewed landing (regions announced for Artemis III; first landing now Artemis IV, 2028)
coord_note: Region list from NASA (Oct 2024). DERIVED PROXY: western rim of Nobile crater = USGS center (-85.2752, 53.2725; http://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/4321) moved ~36 km (crater radius) west along the parallel. Region described as on Mons Mouton near the western rim of Nobile (Wueller et al. 2026, JGR Planets, https://doi.org/10.1029/2025JE009434); point lies inside LROC mosaic NAC_ROI_MTMOUTONLOB. Not verified as the region centre.

name: Nobile Rim 2 (candidate region)
mission: Artemis crewed landing (regions announced for Artemis III; first landing now Artemis IV, 2028)
coord_note: Region list from NASA (Oct 2024). Coordinates = best-ranked point inside region 'DM2 (Nobile Rim 2)' from a multi-criteria study (84 12'05.6" S, 60 41'59.6" E; https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.19863, Acta Astronautica 226, 2025). PROXY: a point in the region, not an official region center or landing site.
